rules.title: GitHub Action uses a mutable branch reference
rules.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a reviewed full commit SHA and let dependency automation propose updates.

rules.title: Checkout credentials remain available to later steps
rules.remediation: Set persist-credentials to false unless later steps explicitly require GitHub token-backed pushes.

rules.title: GitHub Actions grants write-all permissions
rules.remediation: Declare the minimum required permissions and default unspecified scopes to none.

rules.title: Dynamic JavaScript eval
rules.remediation: Avoid eval and use a safe parser for the expected input format.

rules.title: Potential DOM XSS sink
rules.remediation: Use textContent or sanitize trusted HTML with a maintained sanitizer.

rules.title: Dynamic Python eval
rules.remediation: Avoid eval; parse and validate structured input explicitly.

rules.title: Unsafe Python deserialization
rules.remediation: Do not deserialize untrusted pickle data; use a constrained data format such as JSON and validate its schema.

rules.title: Shell command execution enabled
rules.remediation: Pass an argument list with shell=False and validate all user-controlled values.

rules.title: Container build pipes a download to a shell
rules.remediation: Download a pinned artifact, verify its checksum or signature, and execute it as a separate build step.

rules.title: Container base image uses the latest tag
rules.remediation: Pin the base image to a reviewed immutable digest or explicit version tag.

rules.title: Container runs as root
rules.remediation: Create and switch to an unprivileged user.

rules.title: Terraform configures a public object-storage ACL
rules.remediation: Use a private ACL and grant narrowly scoped access through an explicit policy.

rules.title: Terraform allows ingress from the internet
rules.remediation: Restrict ingress CIDRs and ports to required sources.

rules.title: AWS access key in source
rules.remediation: Revoke the key, remove it from history, and use a secret manager.

rules.title: GitHub token in source
rules.remediation: Revoke the token and replace it with a short-lived credential.

rules.title: High-entropy credential in secret-like assignment
rules.remediation: Rotate the credential, remove it from source and history, and load it from a managed secret store.

rules.title: Private key in source
rules.remediation: Remove and rotate the key; load it from a managed secret store.
